title: R&D Mechanical Engineering Intern - Thorlabs
shortDescription: Product development for Imaging Systems division.
description:
At Thorlabs, I worked as a Mechanical Engineering intern as part of the R&D team of the imaging systems division, a business unit specializing in microscopy solutions for biomedical applications.

As part of the R&D team, I created a line of cage adapter brackets used for advanced laser applications. With Thorlabs' in house manufacturing facilities, I was able to see and cotnribute to the full product development process from initial idiation to comercial launch.

I also created the company's first full SolidWorks assembly of the Bergamo III, the company's flagship multiphoton microscope. The assembly contained over 3000 parts and was fully integrated in the company's product lifecycle management (PLM) software, meaning that changes to any of the contained parts would automatically be included into the full assembly.

Finally, I designed aluminum Jigs for Thorlabs' cooled cameras, improving manufacturing speed by reducing the number of required fixtures. I manufactured the parts using a Tormach CNC machine, allowing me to gain hands on experience in CNC programming while reinforcing my understanding of design-for-manufacturing (DFM) principles.
